study: Aquifer-conductivity epistemic bracket propagated through the Phase 3 annualisation (defence-brief item A2)

scope.statement: matrix-d70 and prior-side ONLY. No bulk-d70 conductivity arm has ever been run and no Phase 2 posterior exists for any arm. Quote this scope wherever any number here is quoted.

gate_1_reproduces_production_table.criterion: every field string-identical to the published table

gate_2_arm_provenance.criterion: grid equal to baseline, N = 1e5, config hash round-trips, expected prior_mean_scenario label

gate_3_non_bep_segments_invariant.criterion: every segment with no BEP source is bit-identical to baseline under every arm

P1.statement: KP 62.0 is the only section whose historical ordering is contestable

P2.statement: at KP 62.0 historical the low-conductivity arm hands the lead to overflow

P3.statement: KP 62.0 at +4K reverses under both downward arms and holds under the upward arm

P4.statement: the upward arm reverses no ordering anywhere

P5.statement: KP 57.4 and KP 60.0 cannot reverse historically, because overflow is exactly zero there

P6.statement: the climate ratio rises under the downward arms and falls under the upward arm

P7.statement: the blanket unit weight control changes no ordering and is at least an order of magnitude quieter than the quietest conductivity arm

F1.statement: the upward arm reverses an ordering (would indict the arms)

F3.statement: the annualised conductivity span is narrower than the published length-effect bracket at every section (would deflate the study)

F5.statement: if P1 fails it fails at KP 58.8 historical, the smallest finite margin outside KP 62.0

lambda_ac_bracket_yardstick.definition: published system P_f at lambda_ac = 40 m divided by 250 m, posterior side, matrix, primary surface (phase3_report section 6.2)
